title: Prove optimal linear-bit canonical rotation switch queries
body:
The exact canonical padded-rotation switch predicate has **Theta(h) worst-case bit cost** and O(h) temporary storage. A closed formula replaces the repeated descent in [PR #7504](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7504), whose published arithmetic bound is O(h^2). A matching bit-probe lower bound makes the new order of growth sharp. This is an arithmetic construction with a scoped proof; **No new kappa** or complete physical caller improvement follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/PROOF.md), [direct query](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/query.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57bb6efed1be1dda9eb1a0f622ec2773bc8b0047/research/rotation-switch-closed-descent/CREDITS.md).

For height h, modulus s, offset a, row j and its current wire x, the formula is:

```text
d = min(j, 2h-2-j),  M = 2^d-1,  t = x mod 2^d
A = floor((a+t)/2^d)
B = floor((s-a+M-t)/2^d)
```

Either zero length means identity. Otherwise one retained endpoint formula at height h-d and wire x shifted by d gives the exact canonical bit. The proof covers every legal height and handles offset reduction, empty children and padded-wire switches. It uses a fixed number of linear binary operations. The lower bound needs h-1 input-bit probes for padded offsets, or h-2 for minimal positive encodings, without query advice or preprocessing.

| Check | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Canonical graph compiler and source recurrence | 1,633,182 entries each, all 2,793 networks at heights 1 through 6 |
| Routed permutation endpoints | 152,526 routed addresses |
| Closed descent | 892,854 states |
| Wider queries | 420 source comparisons through height 4096; explicit cases through height 65536 |
| Rejection and sensitivity | 12 invalid domains, 5 changed formulas, 8,479 one-bit changes |

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rotation-switch-closed-descent
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_ROTATION_SWITCH_CLOSED_DESCENT optimal O(h) bit query
```

Normal and optimized replay, committed bytes/source history/modes, package export and read-only Git-free serial exported replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44389148736/job/135101717781) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. The executable height cap is 65536; the proof is not a finite-size extrapolation.

Nick Petalas supplied the [endpoint and child theorem](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7efb9a84277ec31abe2a934aeef8c8a70548aa5b/research/canonical-rotation-switch-query/PROOF.md). Cinna Davis supplied the [canonical compiler](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a/research/unconditional-batched-crt/check_batched_crt.py) in [PR #4100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4100). Their retained executables are unchanged comparison dependencies. Jerry Chen's [PR #7593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7593), head `56335a406469fad85e88ff72820d506d8bea6f63`, provides related fourteen-tape lowering of the earlier recurrence; this contribution does not replace its physical proof.

Current-state CRT offset production, serialized descriptors, owned predicate return, clearing, head restoration, payload consumption and complete workload pricing remain open. The comparison does not claim measured runtime speedup or a lower bound for preprocessed repeated queries. Historical suites, physical caller replay, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions remain and the selected frontier is unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. The consumed PR7504 head is `7efb9a84277ec31abe2a934aeef8c8a70548aa5b`; the canonical compiler pin is `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`. Six retained files have exact byte pins and preserved notices. No unmerged source ancestry is asserted. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. This is source-aware author checking, not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19717166).
